summary: Iteration 9 – Anteprima Video Shop. Backend: generated a 3s testsrc mp4 via imageio-ffmpeg, chunked-uploaded it, created a shop item (kind=video) and verified preview_url is populated and serves an image/jpeg via GET /api/media/{id}. Regen POST /shop/items/{id}/preview returns 200 with a NEW preview_media_id; unknown id → 404; club_manager → 403. Public endpoints (/api/public/tournaments/{slug}/matches/{mid}/shop and /api/public/tournaments/{slug}) both include the video item with preview_url. Frontend: public tournament home /tornei/la-serie-a-dei-bambini renders home-shop cards with for existing video item 6aaa9ce13e4ac1597866ce92; Match Center match-center-shop renders 4 thumbnails (photos+video). Admin MEDIA tab of match 6aaa5ce2cfb606f5c0fb7560 shows shop-row-* with shop-row-preview-* thumbnails for items that have a preview and shop-preview-regen-* ONLY on items without preview (the two pre-existing TEST_iter5_video rows). Suspended the freshly created TEST_QA video item via PATCH active:false to keep the workspace clean; Highlights test and legacy items untouched. All 7 pytest tests PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: club_extras.py:_video_frame – ffmpeg subprocess runs synchronously inside async request handler, blocking the event loop for up to 60s twice (2s + 0.5s fallback). Consider offloading to a thread (asyncio.to_thread) or a background job; preview generation currently blocks the API response of POST /shop/items (observed ~2s latency on a tiny 3s clip; will grow for real videos).

club_extras.py:create_item – if _make_preview returns None (extraction fails), the item is still created with preview_media_id=None. That is fine (Genera anteprima button covers it in the UI), but there is no error signalling to the caller. Consider returning a warning flag in the response payload so the client can surface a hint.
club_extras.py:regen_preview – on regeneration success, the old preview MediaFile is not deleted (orphaned in storage). Consider best-effort cleanup of the previous preview_media_id.

club_extras.py: ffmpeg timeout=60 with two attempts means worst-case 120s per request, exceeding typical ingress timeouts. Cap total elapsed time (single subprocess run with a `-ss ... -itsoffset` fallback via ffmpeg-lavfi select filter, or a shorter timeout).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (home-shop image, match-center-shop images, admin shop-row thumbnails + regen-only-on-missing)
